messages:
alex: FYI customer reported 401s immediately after we rotated their OAuth client secret in Vault. They say requests from their backend started failing but browser SSO flows still work.

maya: Interesting — that sounds like a server-to-server client creds flow failing (invalid_client)? Do we have logs? :eyes:

sre-bot: Incident created #INC-9521. Collected initial logs from edge: repeated `invalid_client` responses from IdP at 10.11.12.13.

jordan: I pulled the customer's proxy logs: auth server returns 401, body: `{"error":"invalid_client","error_description":"Client authentication failed"}`. Token endpoint hits the old client secret.

alex: They rotate client_secret in our Vault KV (transit+kv-v2). We write out to their env via operator -> sidecar picks up secret and restarts app. But operator logs show `kv get` succeeded but sidecar restart hook didn't run because rollout annotation was unchanged.

sam: That would leave pods with old ENV secrets, so app keeps hitting IdP with wrong secret. Can they repro on their cluster? Ask for `kubectl get pods -o yaml` and `kubectl describe deployment`.

maya: Asked customer for reproducer commands. They ran: ```bash
# shows env in container
kubectl exec -it svc/backend -- printenv | grep CLIENT_SECRET
# vault read
vault kv get -format=json secret/data/prod/oauth | jq -r .data.data.client_secret
# curl token endpoint
curl -s -X POST https://idp.example.com/oauth/token \
  -d grant_type=client_credentials \
  -u "CLIENT_ID:$OLD_SECRET" | jq .
```

alex: Customer pasted results: Vault shows new secret, container env still has old secret. Their operator log contains `skipRestart: no annotation change`.

jordan: So root cause = operator relies on a rolling-annotation diff to trigger rollout, but our Vault KV sync path updates value only and doesn't touch annotation if the value change happened via an alias/rewrap path. Edge case.

sam: Quick mitigation: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/backend` or `kubectl set env deployment/backend CLIENT_SECRET=$(vault kv get -field=client_secret secret/data/prod/oauth)` — that'll flush env. Sent that to customer.

alex: Customer confirmed `rollout restart` fixed it, tokens issued successfully. They still want a durable fix so rotation is atomic.

maya: Proposed permanent fixes: 1) operator: detect KV version change and set rotation annotation automatically; 2) sidecar: watch Vault secret path and auto-reload without requiring annotation; 3) add a baked-in `rotation-wait` hook in our operator for Private installs.

support-bot: Note logged to customer record: patch suggested and workaround applied. Ticket updated.

jordan: Also found a secondary cause risk: our internal alt-KV (etcd cache used by operator) wasn't invalidated on Vault replication. If Vault rewrap occurs in-place, our cache TTL kept old value for ~5m. Need to invalidate cache on `version` or `metadata.updated_time`.

alex: Next steps assigned: maya -> propose operator PR to toggle annotation on secret version change; sam -> add env-watch to sidecar; jordan -> add telemetry that alerts when token endpoint returns `invalid_client` for >10% of requests in 5m.

maya: I'll prototype annotation toggle today, sending a draft PR. We'll include a unit test mocking kv metadata change.

sam: I'll open a follow-up GH issue for sidecar reload; quick fix is to document `rollout restart` in rotation runbook.

alex: Thanks all. Marking resolved for customer; retaining postmortem notes and action items. :checkered_flag:

support-bot: Closing thread, adding follow-up task to roadmap: operator/rotation-safety. :calendar:
